name: Papyrus
description: Papyrus umbels: a straight stem opening into a fixed fan of rays, repeated the length of the bank.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 46%; top: 44%; width: 8%; height: 56%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; top: 4%; width: 84%; height: 48%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 100%, 2% 6%, 16% 2%, 50% 62%, 84% 2%, 98% 6%); clip-path: polygon(50% 100%, 2% 6%, 16% 2%, 50% 62%, 84% 2%, 98% 6%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
